summary: LogProstyle Inc. filed a Form 6-K reporting the results of its Annual General Meeting of Shareholders held on June 30, 2026. The meeting covered routine matters: approval of the Business Report and Non-Consolidated Financial Statements for the fiscal year ended March 31, 2026, and the election of six director nominees, all of whom were elected with substantial shareholder support. No special-situation event such as an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, or restructuring was disclosed. This is a standard periodic report of meeting outcomes, mapping to a U.S. Form 8-K Item 5.07. No further action or event-driven analysis is warranted.
